features.title: Wrap fee-bearing Tessera T-Tokens so they can quote a Meteora DBC launch

product_gate.user: Tessera tKalshi and tOpenAI holders and launchers quoting in them

product_gate.job: launch a bonding-curve token priced in a Tessera T-Token
product_gate.verb: wrap tKalshi 1:1 and create a DBC pool quoted in the wrapped mint
